notes: Union Republicans elected county committee in the June 4, 2024 primary (separate male and female contests) and again on the June 2, 2026 primary ballot, used here: one 'Members of County Committee' contest per election district (434 districts), Vote for 2, so the results do not say which winner holds the male or female seat and seats are labeled 'Member'. Filled = a named candidate in the top two with more votes than all write-ins combined and than the next named candidate. Empty = a slot with no named winner where the district cast zero write-in votes. Unknown = a slot with no named candidate where write-ins were cast (write-in winners not named), or a tie. 174 districts had no named Republican candidate; 3 had more than two. Contest totals in the Clarity summary are not subject to district-level privacy suppression. Precinct names are the contest suffix as printed.
